_about: Public-domain Félicité de Lamennais (1782-1854) in English for the Word Hoard: Words of a Believer (New York, 1834), The People's Own Book (Boston, 1839), the Essay on Indifference in Matters of Religion, tr. Lord Stanley of Alderley (London, 1895), and Sermonettes, tr. J. L. Jacobson van Hemert (Chicago, 1904), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 29 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
